description:
Search restaurants in Lanzarote that publish their menu through Aventurator Gastro (digital, multilingual QR menus). This is a directory lookup only — restaurants are visited in person, there is no ordering or booking through this tool.

Args:
  - query (string, optional): free-text match against restaurant name/tagline/description
  - limit (number, optional, 1-50, default 20)
  - offset (number, optional, default 0)

Returns: restaurant profiles (name, tagline, address, languages available) with a menu_url for get_restaurant_menu or direct browsing.
name: search_restaurants
title: Search Aventurator Gastro Restaurants
